description: Header file declaring functions for generating and broadcasting device events in a device management system, including discovery, device status, resource updates, and Zigbee events.

methods.name: startDeviceEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the device event producer system.

methods.name: stopDeviceEventProducer
methods.description: Shuts down the device event producer system.

methods.name: sendDiscoveryStartedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating discovery has started for specified device classes with a timeout.

methods.name: sendDiscoveryStoppedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating discovery has stopped for a device class.

methods.name: sendDeviceDiscoveredEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that a device has been discovered.

methods.name: sendDeviceDiscoveryFailedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that device discovery has failed for a specific device.

methods.name: sendDeviceRejectedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that a device was rejected.

methods.name: sendDeviceDiscoveryCompletedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that device discovery has completed.

methods.name: sendDeviceAddedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that a device has been added.

methods.name: sendDeviceRecoveredEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that a device has recovered.

methods.name: sendDeviceRemovedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that a device has been removed.

methods.name: sendResourceUpdatedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that a device resource has been updated.

methods.name: sendEndpointAddedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that an endpoint has been added.

methods.name: sendEndpointRemovedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that an endpoint has been removed.

methods.name: sendReadyForDevicesEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating readiness for devices.

methods.name: sendZigbeeChannelChangedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that the Zigbee channel has changed.

methods.name: sendZigbeeNetworkInterferenceEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating Zigbee network interference detection.

methods.name: sendZigbeePanIdAttackEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating Zigbee PAN ID attack detection.

methods.name: sendDeviceConfigureStartedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that device configuration has started.

methods.name: sendDeviceConfigureCompletedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that device configuration has completed.

methods.name: sendDeviceConfigureFailedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event that device configuration has failed.
